name: How do I choose the right type of roof ventilation for my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right type of roof ventilation for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right ventilation depends on your roof's design, attic size, climate, and existing ventilation. Options include static vents, ridge vents, soffit vents, and powered attic fans. A professional assessment will consider these factors and recommend a balanced system of both intake and exhaust ventilation. For instance, in Texas, a combination of continuous ridge and soffit vents is often effective.
acceptedAnswer.description: The right ventilation depends on roof design, attic size, and climate; a professional assessment can recommend a balanced system.
